extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.68[CR]- Check Windows effective HDCP protection while asynchronous preparation remains pending, in both the Python and owned native adapter waiters.[CR]- Retain a pending request through playback only when the requested protection is independently verified; preserve genuine level-2 enforcement and treat unknown protection as unavailable.[CR]- Record effective state, async status, HRESULT, wait checks and screen mode to diagnose NUC HDCP startup timeouts and display blanking.[CR]- Retain native HD in stock Kodi, persistent pinned Chrome reuse, catalog and Watchlist speed improvements, and all accumulated fixes.
